resources.string:
Unfret looks at a shop page, an ad or a service provider's page and tells you in plain words whether it all adds up.

• Share a link to Unfret from any app, or paste it here. The page opens inside Unfret, on your phone, over your own connection, so you can accept a cookie banner or solve a captcha.

• Nothing is read until you tap Check this page. Then Unfret reads the page on your phone: the product facts and the visible text. Account menus, greetings, forms, checkout and delivery areas, and any address that isn't the business's own are removed first. On a private seller's ad, the seller's name is never read.

• Only those facts, that text and the page address are sent, to unfret.net, with your Unfret key. Nothing about you or your phone.

• Each check uses one check from your key. Checks are bought on unfret.net, not in this app.

• The app keeps only your key on the phone, encrypted. Pages you open aren't kept: their cookies and cache are deleted when you close them.
Paste a product or ad link
Or share a link to Unfret from your browser or a marketplace app.
Set up your key below, then check this link.
Paste your Unfret key to start. You get one when you buy checks on unfret.net.
Checks are bought on unfret.net. Come back here when you have your key.
It starts with ufk_. It is stored on this phone only, encrypted.
That isn\'t an Unfret key (it starts with ufk_).
The server doesn\'t know this key (or it was replaced with its recovery code).
Remove the key from this phone?
Its checks stay on the key. Keep a copy of it (or its recovery code) to use it again.
Use the dev server (dev.unfret.net, test network)
Loading the page… Accept a cookie banner or solve a captcha if one appears.
When the page shows the product or ad, tap Check this page. It uses one check.
Reading the page on your phone…

Unfret reports risk signals from what the page shows; it never calls a shop a scam. The page may change after this check.
